items.title: Voice mode that understands you, and a face for it
items.text: Voice mode answers in the language you speak, hears better in a noisy room, and plays a soft sound while it thinks. Choose an avatar, Ratatoskr, Pebble or Lumen, whose mouth moves as Toskar talks, and make voice personas everyone can pick from.

items.title: Features that set themselves up
items.text: Settings › Features lists what Toskar can do on this computer, with Ready or Needs setup beside each. Set up installs everything a feature still needs in one step. Settings has a list of its pages and a search over setting names.

items.title: Works with apps made for Ollama and OpenAI
items.text: Toskar speaks Ollama's API too, so apps that only offer Ollama can use it. The OpenAI-compatible API adds embeddings, speech to text and read aloud, and apps that bring their own tools, such as Home Assistant's Assist or n8n, can use auto and profiles.

items.title: A faster first reply
items.text: Toskar keeps your main chat model ready when there's room for it, and the apps start loading it as soon as you open a chat or start typing. An Admin chooses once whether it stays loaded or frees its memory when needed.

items.title: See everything that left this computer
items.text: What left this computer now lists every model download and search, setup file, speech model, MCP connection and the other sites a page loaded, so you can check that your conversations stay on your own computer.

items.title: The front door, in the visitor's language
items.text: The doorbell answers a visitor in the language they speak and sends you a note in yours. A Reolink Home Hub brings its other cameras with it, and an automation's history can be cleared without deleting the automation.
